features.name: Passive imported enum field annotations with payloads
features.scope: Exact public/static/final self-typed enum constant reads with runtime or binary declaration annotations carrying scalar and array values; verified Kotlin and Java enum dependencies
restrictions: Exact public/static/final enum constants with self-typed descriptors only
No recovery for ordinary annotated fields, field signatures, type-use annotations, synthetic fields, nullability/type-qualifier annotations or Kotlin semantic annotations and opt-in meta-annotations
Passive annotation inspection checks structural class metadata and qualifier meta-annotations without requiring annotation implementation Kotlin metadata to be at the compiler pin
